info.title: FuelLog API
info.description: Backend with identity, vehicles, fuel purchases and summaries. Protected queries enforce ownership; monetary values use decimal strings. Editing and soft deletion preserve original idempotency fingerprints and UUID tombstones. Consumption cycles, km/L and cost/km contracts were removed with unused fueling fields in V8; exports remain planned.

put.summary: Edit an owned vehicle without replacing its identity or history
put.description: Transactional edit serialized with fuel-entry creation. model is trimmed and also updates internal nickname for existing selectors. accepted fuels govern new entries only; historical fuel purchases stay unchanged. Optional fields omitted or null become unknown (null). currentOdometerKm is an independent snapshot: it does not constrain or rewrite fuel history. Read the latest GET vehicle and send its ETag; after a 412 reload and let the user reconcile the form before resubmitting.

put.summary: Update an owned fuel entry in place
put.description: Preserves entry UUID, vehicle, owner and original creation fingerprint. Requires one strong numeric If-Match ETag from GET. Each accepted PUT advances the version, including unchanged values. Retrying with the old ETag returns 412: refetch and resolve before retrying. Original POST retries return the current edited entry without overwriting it or creating another entry. Archived vehicles may have their historical entries corrected. New fuel selections must be allowed by the vehicle; the entry current historical fuel may remain unchanged. Odometer chronology excludes this entry and validates its new date and ties. Does not modify other entries or consume a pending vehicle history gap.

post.summary: Change password and revoke every session
post.description: Requires the current password and a different new password (6..128 characters). If 2FA is enabled, secondFactorCode is required and accepts TOTP or one unused recovery code. All sessions, including the current session and every refresh token, are revoked after success; the app must log in again. Credential version invalidates pending MFA setups and challenges. Never log submitted credentials.

post.description: Requires an unused valid TOTP step from a pending setup in the same session, before its 5-minute deadline and matching credential version. Returns 10 single-use recovery codes once; only hashes are persisted.

post.description: Public only for exact POST /api/v1/auth/2fa/verify. Challenge is opaque, hashed at rest, single-use, valid for 5 minutes and bound to user and credential version. Accepts TOTP (SHA1/6 digits/30 seconds, at most one adjacent step, with replay protection) or one unused recovery code. Only success creates a session and issues TokenResponse. Atomic consumption under user lock prevents concurrent recovery/challenge reuse; failed password login never issues a challenge.

get.summary: Read owned vehicle dashboard aggregates and complete series
get.description: Aggregates every active purchase in the requested civil-date and fuel filters. Returns monthly spending, spending by fuel, declared unit-price evolution and monthly liters. Weighted unit price uses sum(unitPrice * liters) / sum(liters); paid totals use actual payment. Consumption cycles, km/L and cost/km are no longer available.

anyOf.description: Positive decimal string using a dot; excessive precision is rejected without silent rounding.

currentOdometerKm.description: Optional odometer reading in whole km reported at vehicle creation; omitted/null means unknown, including existing vehicles. Returned unchanged by POST /vehicles and GET /vehicles or /vehicles/{vehicleId}. This is a registration snapshot, not a computed latest fuel-entry reading; fuel entries do not update it. It does not constrain retroactive fuel entries. Negative values return 422; fractional, string, boolean and out-of-int64 inputs return 400.

anyOf.description: Positive decimal string using a dot; excessive precision is rejected without silent rounding.

currentOdometerKm.description: Optional odometer snapshot reported at creation or replaced by PUT /vehicles/{vehicleId}; omitted/null on PUT clears it. GET and list return the persisted reading. Fuel entries do not update it; it does not constrain retroactive entries. Legacy creation accepts int64; edits accept safe integers 0..9007199254740991.

CreateFuelEntry.description: New UUIDs require latitude and longitude. Exact original pre-GPS retries may omit both. Original request fingerprints are retained through edits and migration; commands with unreproducible legacy fields safely conflict. Unknown JSON properties retain the existing ignored-property policy; removed properties are not stored, returned or used. Required purchase values and GPS rules remain enforced.

UpdateVehicle.description: Only these four fields are editable. model also sets nickname; legacy fields are not part of this command.

model.description: Required nonblank model after Unicode whitespace trimming.

allowedFuels.description: Required nonempty selection; null members are invalid. Changes apply to new fuel entries only.

currentOdometerKm.description: Optional safe JSON integer in whole km; omitted/null clears the snapshot. Negative/unsafe integers return 422; fractional, string, boolean or out-of-int64 JSON values return 400. Independent of historical fuel readings.

tankCapacityLiters.description: Optional positive decimal string with a dot, greater than 0 and less than 100000, at most three decimal places (NUMERIC(8,3)); no rounding. Omitted/null clears capacity. Invalid values return 422; JSON numbers/booleans return 400.

UpdateFuelEntry.description: Editable purchase fields without client UUID. Retains strict monetary validation, precision and If-Match versioning. Omitted or null GPS pair preserves the historical snapshot; a non-null pair replaces it after range and precision validation. Unknown JSON properties retain the existing ignored-property policy; removed properties are not stored, returned or used. Required purchase values and GPS rules remain enforced.
